severity.critical: Unsafe cancellation/billing guidance, a material late change incorrectly cleared, or a rollout safety trigger missed.
severity.major: An unresolved preparation, delivery or follow-up requirement that needs a named owner's action. Missing evidence is not proof of harm.
severity.non_finding: A supported exception, phase-appropriate absence or unchanged artifact that must not create an unsupported block.
